reviews.text: Smart Bird ID should be called Genius Bird ID! 🐦‍⬛🪶🐦🦉🕊️❤️. I’m fairly new to being a “birder” but I feel comfortable saying I am one now and thanks to Smart Bird ID I’ve discovered a new hobby that I just love! ❤️ Initially I got this app to identify what birds were making the beautiful birdsong that I enjoyed so much every morning. But now I have learned so much from Smart Bird that I can identify most of the birds that visit our backyard daily by sight & sound. We have even taken to naming our favorite birds that visit every day. I love the way you can identify a bird with a recording or a photo. Their ID is very accurate and then you can click on that particular bird and learn everything about it, see more photos and listen to it’s bird calls & songs. There are also free articles to read on a great range of bird topics, courses & quizzes you can take and best of all you can post your own photos, recordings & videos to share with other bird lovers and see theirs. And a really fun part of participating on this app with other bird enthusiasts is the Smart Bird ornithologists award medals for the best photos & recordings and they do a weekly Top of the Week review of the top posts. It’s not done in a competitive spirit but rather encourages us all to share so we can learn more about birds in our area and beyond. We are fortunate to have an abundance of a wide variety of backyard birds but we also enjoy seeing bird posts from other States and countries. We would rarely get to see a bald Eagle or Red Tailed Hawk if it weren’t for Smart Bird. We have learned how to set up our bird feeders & birdbaths and the birds are now in our backyard from sunrise to sunset. ☺️ We love to feed them and observe their behavior and capture images of them. My husband affectionately calls me a “crazy bird lady” now but I’m proud and happy to help the birds and they give me much more than I give them because it brings me such peace & joy. I researched bird ID apps before I chose Smart Bird and I also got Merlin which is great too and very accurate also but I have to say Smart Bird is so much more fun and worth the small price to pay to be part of this wonderful birding family. reviews.text: Excellent app. This app has helped me progress my birding knowledge so much! It’s very helpful in identifying new birds and keeping track of birds I’ve viewed along with allowing me to quiz myself on different bird types. I personally really love the quizzes and find them super helpful for learning!

Great response. I’m new to my southern Colorado mountain home and used the app to identify several birds. I reached out to the app contact when I had difficulty identifying a small nesting bird and had a very quick response with identification.

The only bird app you need. This app has saved me so much time searching for types of birds online. And one step further...I recently had a bird in my area that the app didn’t turn up results. This app has a link for email support. In less than 24 hours of emailing a pic, an expert email me back the type of bird I saw. A double crested cormorant in northern Illinois! How fun! Thank you Michael!

I’m learning so much!. I am relatively new to birdwatching, and what got me interested was hearing their songs and their calls. I live on the water in North West Alabama, so when I walk outside, I like to know who’s outside with me. This app has been so helpful with identifying the birds by sound and sight! Very happy with this app! I highly recommend it for those who are curious like me. So many beautiful birds, there’s so much to learn about them. Thank you for making this available.

Perfect app for curious bird watchers. I just love this app. We recently built a home in the woods in northern NH and was amazed at all our singing birds. They keep themselves well hidden but we wanted to know what type of birds we were hearing. The listening feature works well and appears to be very accurate in identifying our feathered neighbors.

Perfect app for Bird Lovers. I’m not very versed in bird watching so this tool is the perfect app for me! We sit out on our back patio and listen to the birds wake up for the day singing their songs. Now we know which birds they are! Amazing!
